nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balance: token balances of every holder
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances: ERC20 allowances
mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromFee: addresses exempt from the tax
uint256 private _tTotal: total supply (60000000 * 10**8)
uint256 private _taxFee: transfer tax percentage applied on transfers
address payable private _from: destination of the collected ETH fee, also used in an inverted balance check
uint256 private _maxTxAmount: maximum amount per buy transaction
uint256 private _maxWallet: maximum balance a wallet may hold after a buy
IUniswapV2Router02 private _uniswap: hardcoded Uniswap V2 router instance
address private _pair: created Uniswap pair address
bool private _canTrade: trading-enabled guard flag
bool private _inSwap: re-entrancy guard set by lockTheSwap
bool private _swapEnabled: enables automatic contract-token to ETH swaps
address private _owner (Ownable): privileged address checked by onlyOwner
RugalInu constructor: mints supply, sets router, tax and limits, assigns _from and owner
transfer(address,uint256): public ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): pulls allowance, transfers and re-approves
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core transfer logic with limits, swap trigger and fee routing
_tokenTransfer(...): applies tax math and writes the balance state variables
swapTokensForEth(uint256) private lockTheSwap: approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH via the router
sendETHToFee(uint256) private: forwards ETH to _from via address.transfer
createPair() external onlyOwner: creates the Uniswap pair and grants max allowance
addLiquidity() external onlyOwner: adds ETH/token liquidity and enables trading
increaseMaxTx(uint256) external onlyOwner: raises _maxTxAmount
increaseMaxWallet(uint256) external onlyOwner: raises _maxWallet
reduceTax(uint256) external onlyOwner: lowers _taxFee
manualSwap() external onlyOwner: swaps the whole contract token balance
manualSend() external onlyOwner: sends the whole contract ETH balance to _from
receive() external payable: accepts ETH into the contract
renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0)
_approve(address,address,uint256) private: writes the _allowances mapping
msg.sender / _msgSender(): caller-controlled address used for ownership and transfer origin
block.timestamp: used as router swap/liquidity deadline
external call: _uniswap.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(...) executed inside swapTokensForEth
external call: _from.transfer(amount) sends ETH to a mutable privileged address
external payable call: _uniswap.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance}(...)
external call: IUniswapV2Factory(_uniswap.factory()).createPair(...) with unchecked return usage
external call: IERC20(_pair).approve(router, type(uint).max) grants unlimited allowance
parameter 'from' of _transfer: source address of the token movement
parameter 'to' of _transfer: destination address of the token movement
parameter 'amount' of _transfer: gross amount being moved
parameter 'tAmount' of _tokenTransfer: gross amount before tax
parameter 'taxRate' of _tokenTransfer: tax percentage (0 or _taxFee)
local variable contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer
local variable contractETHBalance = address(this).balance inside _transfer
local variable tTeam = tAmount.mul(taxRate).div(100) inside _tokenTransfer

constructor sets the hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address
constructor initializes _taxFee = 6
constructor sets _maxTxAmount = _tTotal/200
constructor sets _maxWallet = _tTotal/100
constructor excludes the contract itself and _from from fees
constructor assigns _owner from the untrusted caller address
msg.sender becomes the privileged _from and _owner during construction
msg.sender is used as the sender of the public transfer
transfer() delegates all work to the internal _transfer
the 'from' parameter drives every branch of _transfer
the 'to' parameter is checked for zero address and against _pair/owner
the 'amount' parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount and _maxWallet
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this))
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth
contractETHBalance is passed as amount to sendETHToFee
_transfer triggers the automatic token-to-ETH swap
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance reaches 1e18
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer for the actual balance writes
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee of from/to to decide the tax rate
_transfer reads balances through balanceOf to enforce the wallet and _from checks
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on buys
_transfer enforces balanceOf(to) + amount <= _maxWallet on buys
_transfer reads the _inSwap guard before swapping
_transfer reads _swapEnabled before swapping
_transfer compares the from address against the _pair address

_transfer branches on owner() so the owner is exempt from limits and swap logic

normalization_plan.reason: The 'from' parameter only exists inside _transfer and should be collapsed into that core function node.
The 'to' parameter is bound by _transfer and has no independent meaning outside it.
The 'amount' parameter is consumed by _transfer limit checks and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
The 'tAmount' parameter is the input consumed by the _tokenTransfer tax arithmetic.
The 'taxRate' parameter is only used in _tokenTransfer to compute the fee.
The local contractTokenBalance is directly handed to the swapTokensForEth external swap.
The local contractETHBalance is directly handed to sendETHToFee for the ETH payout.
The local tTeam is produced by _tokenTransfer tax arithmetic and folded into its balance writes.
